name: Otsumu Tenten ~Onii-chan to 3nin Musume no Mattari Ecchi na Nichijou~
original_name: おつむてんてん～お兄ちゃんと3人娘のまったりエッチな日常～
source:
Makoto has given up his dream.... He now lives a vacant life working as a part-timer at a game arcade. One day, he is asked to play a crane game and get a stuffed toy for her. Her name is Hina, who often comes to the game arcade, but never gets a stuffed toy. He willingly accepts her offer and gets two stuffed toys. Since then, he becomes friends with Hina and Sayaka, Hina's friend. Makoto also has an old friend, Natsumi, who recently becomes conscious of the opposite sex. Makoto is vaguely aware of her change, but he pretends he doesn't notice it. His lonely life gradually changes spending warm-hearted time with three girls....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
诚放弃了自己的梦想……现在，他在游戏厅打工，过着空虚的生活。有一天，他被要求玩起重机游戏并为她买一个毛绒玩具。她的名字叫希娜，经常来游戏厅，但从来没有得到过毛绒玩具。他欣然接受了她的提议并得到了两个毛绒玩具。从那时起，他与希娜和希娜的朋友沙耶香成为了朋友。诚还有一位老朋友夏美，她最近开始对异性产生了兴趣。真琴隐约意识到她的变化，但他假装没有注意到。他孤独的生活逐渐改变，与三个女孩度过了温馨的时光……

[来自工口游戏商店]
